response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/generalist engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and embedded systems, but his resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core focus of this Principal role. His career progression (Senior/Staff titles, not evidence of IC6-scale multi-team architectural ownership) and lack of statistical/experimentation domain expertise make him a weak fit despite solid general engineering fundamentals.
strengths: 15+ years of broad technical experience across many languages and platforms (TypeScript, DLang, C/C++, Java, C#)
Demonstrated technical leadership via open-source projects, workshops, and community talks
Experience with distributed/microservices systems handling high request volumes (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-platform experience
No mention of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/data-analysis work central to this role
Career titles (Senior/Staff) and project scope don't clearly demonstrate Principal/IC6-level cross-team architectural leadership
